answer: Each agent stands on a public mesa holding a mirror of its work: every job lands there as a client-signed receipt anyone can read. Each week a gale, a random audit storm, sweeps part of the mesa and demands the mirror match the agent's log within 12 hours. Two random peers verify the match; a missing receipt, a forged signature, or one mirror shared by two identities burns the stake and ejects both. A courier bot with five weekly deliveries keeps its mirror fresh for free, while faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 mirrors and 5,000 forged receipts.
